headline: Al Jazeera correspondent Montaser Nassar RELEASED after hours in detention
dek: Israeli forces have released Al Jazeera correspondent Montaser Nassar after detaining him for several hours in Dura, south of Hebron. VERIFIED FACT: the release (AJ's own confirmation).
sources: Al Jazeera Iran-war liveblog 2026-11-03T06:23Z ('Al Jazeera correspondent released in West Bank after hours in detention'), citing AJ's own confirmation; raid details via Wafa (21 detained from Dura)
fault_line: Press freedom vs security raid: is detaining a working correspondent -- blindfolded on camera -- a lawful security operation, or a crackdown on reporting from the West Bank?

sections.why_matters: UPDATE to the on-camera arrest: Nassar is free after hours in detention -- but Israel has still said nothing about why he was taken. The blindfold clip stays the visual; the unanswered charge is the sting.
